item.title: Installation Guide
item.description: This guide is for you and your installer. It covers what to check on delivery, the electrical connection (which must be done by a qualified electrician), the wet test you need to run before final fixing, and how to use your bath safely.When your bath arrivesAs soon as it arrives, inspect the bath to make sure it is the model you ordered and has arrived undamaged. If you find a problem, contact us straight away. Damage caused during handling after delivery is not covered by the warranty. Protect the bath during installation to prevent damage. Never handle the bath by the pipework. Do not stand or place tools directly on the bath finish. Check pump unions; hand-tighten only. Always refer to local building codes.Your whirlpool bath has been carefully assembled and fully water-tested by the manufacturer.Fully wet test the whirlpool system and plumbing before final fixing.Electrical connectionThis bath must be installed by a qualified electrician, and the work must be suitably certified. If it is not, your warranty will be void.Supply requirementsPump: 240V, 13 amp, live, neutral and earth.LED lighting (if fitted): can run off a 5-amp fuse.Inline heater (if fitted): needs a separate 13-amp supply, or it can share the pump connection.Wiring must comply with the current IET Wiring Regulations (BS 7671).The supply must be via an earth leakage circuit breaker / residual current device (ELCB, RCD, RCCB) rated at 20 amp minimum with a 30 milliampere trip current. The supply should be installed on a switched fused spur which, together with the RCD, should be fitted outside the room where the bath is installed.The pump is factory wired with a length of twin and earth flex for connecting to the power supply. If the connection is made in the room where the bath is installed, the connector must be rated to at least IP55.Do not remove the pump during installation. It has been factory-fitted, and removing it may void your warranty.Check the supply to make sure earthing is present and satisfactory.Test procedureCarry out this test before any installation. Do not fix the bath into place, tile to it, seal it in or fit any panels until the test is done. Skipping it may void your warranty. Please keep all packaging, including the delivery pallet, until testing is complete.Make sure the power supply is isolated according to your electrician's instructions and local regulations.Check pump unions are tight.Flush through the pipework, make sure the bath does not contain any debris, and check the suction fitting is clear.Fill the bath with water to completely cover all the jets.Before switching on, thoroughly check the pump, the pump connections, and pipework for leaks.Now switch on the power supply and press the on/off button to start the system.While the system is running, check for leaks.Repeat this test once the final fit is complete.Basic operating instructionsBefore using your bath for the first time, clean it and wipe out any debris.Fill the bath at least 1 inch (about 2.5cm) above the highest jet before turning on the pump. Exposed jets will cause splashing.Never run the pump dry, as this can damage it.Do not leave children unattended in or around an operating whirlpool.Keep your head away from the suction inlet. Hair can be caught in it and cause injury.Do not use high-foaming products such as bubble bath and soap while the pump is running. Low-foam bath oils can be used, though oils can cause build-up in the system and may need extra cleaning.Cleaning and bath productsFor advice on cleaning, see our Whirlpool Bath Cleaning Guide.For advice on which products you can use in your whirlpool or Jacuzzi bath, read Can you use bubble bath or oil in a whirlpool bath?

item.description: Residual Current Circuit BreakerAll our whirlpool baths will require a Residual Current Circuit Breaker, commonly known as an RCCB, which is a safety device used in electrical installations with high earth impedance such as whirlpool baths.You are welcome to source your own RCCB or your electrician can but for your convenience we offer this item which we can supply at the same time as your whirlpool bath.This item will be supplied with your bath, your installer will make the connection.Further InformationFor further information on installing your whirlpool or spa bath please read our Installation Guide

item.title: Cleaning Fluid for Whirlpool Spa and Jacuzzi baths
item.description: Revitalize Your Spa Experience Keep your whirlpool or spa bath in pristine condition with our specially formulated Cleaner & Degreaser. Designed to tackle the unseen grime lurking in your bath’s pipework and pump, this powerful 1-litre solution effortlessly removes grease, body oils, soap scum, and slime buildup—leaving your system fresh, hygienic, and ready for your next soak. Deep Cleaning Power: Targets hidden deposits for a thorough clean, with up to 4 applications per bottle. Customizable Strength: Adjust dilution for regular maintenance or a deep purge—perfect for neglected systems. Safe & Gentle: Acid-free, non-hazardous, and septic-tank friendly; safe for chrome, brass, gold-plated fittings, stainless steel, ceramics, tiles, PVC, and plastics. Eco-Conscious: Fully biodegradable and user-friendly—clean with confidence.How to Use:Simply fill your bath with water, add the recommended dose (typically 250ml for an average bath), and run the whirlpool system for 10-15 minutes with the air valve closed to minimize foaming. Drain, rinse, and enjoy a spotless spa bath. For best results, use every 3-4 weeks alongside our Pure-Spa Sanitiser Tablets. Why It Matters:Regular cleaning prevents bacterial growth and prolongs the life of your pump and pipes—even if your bath sits unused. Say goodbye to murky water and hello to a luxurious, worry-free soak every time. Transform your whirlpool bath into a sanctuary of cleanliness and relaxation.

item.title: Chromotherapy Mood Lighting System – 24 LED Lights for Whirlpool Baths
item.description: Important: This is a Mood Lighting Upgrade only — it does not include a bath.You must select a compatible Trojan or Beaufort whirlpool bath separately, then add this lighting system to your basket along with the bath.Create a Relaxing Spa Atmosphere with 24 LED LightsTransform your whirlpool bath into a wellness retreat with this premium Chromotherapy Mood Lighting System. Twenty-four tiny, twinkling LED lights illuminate the water in beautiful colours, helping you unwind and creating a harmonious, calming ambience.Easy Bath-Mounted ControlOn/Off switchChoose single colours: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo or VioletMulti-colour mode: gently fades through the full rainbow cyclePause on your favourite colour with one touchKey BenefitsEnhances relaxation and promotes a feeling of well-beingComplements your whirlpool or air spa jets perfectlyDiscreet, low-profile LEDs keep the bath surface smooth and safeCreates a magical, glowing effect when bathroom lights are dimmedCompatibilityCan be added to any Trojan or Beaufort whirlpool bath in our storeFully factory-fitted and water-tested before deliveryWarranty: 3-year warranty on the lighting system and controller.How to OrderChoose your Trojan or Beaufort whirlpool bath.Add this 24-LED Mood Lighting System to your basket.Our team will fit and test everything at the factory before delivery.Ready to bathe in colour and calm? Select your bath first, then add this premium upgrade.Frequently Asked QuestionsIs this the same as the single underwater bath light?No. The single light (£169) is one large multi-coloured LED. This system includes 24 small twinkling LEDs for a more dramatic, evenly spread glow.Can this be fitted to any bath? Yes, it works with any Trojan or Beaufort whirlpool bath in our store.Do I need a separate electrical supply? It can usually share the existing 13-amp fused spur with the pump. Full details are in our installation guide.Is the system already included in some baths? No. This mood lighting system is not included in any baths as standard.About ChromotherapyHistory documents the beneficial uses of colour dating back to ancient Egyptian cultures, who built solariums fitted with coloured panes of glass to bathe the occupant in colour. Many cultures believe that chromotherapy or colour therapy can be beneficial in promoting healing to the mind and body, and who are we to argue?What we do know is that different colours can create an ambience and a general feeling of well-being. Our tiny, twinkling, chromotherapy lights reflect the colours of the rainbow and are designed to give the user the option of bathing in a sea of harmonious colours, gently fading from one to another, or to select a favourite that reflects their mood of the momentJust dim your bathroom lights and treat yourself to some, or all of the following:Red - The colour of life, the glowing sun and fire - and of course, desireOrange - An energising, cheerful symbol of the rising sun, to make us feel alert - a great wake-up callYellow - The brightest of the colours symbolising the sun at the horizon - rise and shine each morningGreen - Nature at its most verdant, harmonious and positive - a great motivatorBlue - The colour of peace and infinity, and the most perfect summer sky - drift away to a state of repose and tranquillityIndigo - A cooling, relaxing and calming colour - complete chill outViolet - Just the right hue to indulge in a little meditation - gather your thoughts and file away those uncertainties

item.description: Introducing our latest range of panels, expertly crafted to complement our Beaufort whirlpool baths. These white acrylic panels are an essential addition to any modern bathroom, offering both practicality and style.Please note that we only supply panels with our whirlpool baths and do not ship panels separately by carrier. item.title: Beaufort Margravine Freestanding Bath 1660 x 730 mm
item.description: Introducing the Beaufort Margravine Freestanding Bath, crafted to the highest standards with exceptional quality control measures in place. This exquisite bath is made in Britain using double-skinned acrylic, providing durability and strength while ensuring a long-lasting product. The Beaufort Margravine boasts a 4mm acrylic thickness and comes with a 25-year guarantee, giving you peace of mind with your purchase.Choose from a sleek Gloss White or sophisticated Gloss Grey finish to match your bathroom's decor. This freestanding bath includes waste fittings and an overflow for easy installation and maintenance. With a minimalist design, the Beaufort Margravine does not come with pre-drilled tap holes, providing you with flexibility in your tap selection.Experience the ultimate in luxury and relaxation with the Beaufort Margravine Freestanding Bath.DimensionsLength: 1660mmWidth: 730mmInstalled height: 570mmWater capacity: 195 litresTaps are for illustration only.About Beaufort Freestanding BathsIntroducing the Beaufort line of freestanding baths, crafted with British manufacturing excellence and technical innovation that sets the standard for the industry. Each Beaufort bath is manufactured in the UK with meticulous attention to detail and precision using the latest technology and techniques. At the heart of every Beaufort bath lies a 4mm Asterite sanitary ware grade cell cast acrylic sheet. Unlike many other acrylic baths, the colour is embedded all the way through the material rather than just being a surface layer. This not only ensures a consistent finish but also provides greater durability and resistance to wear and tear.The vacuum forming process is carried out on state-of-the-art vertical vacuum forming machines capable of heating the acrylic precisely to ensure an even form and consistent material thickness. Each bath is manufactured to meet the rigorous standards set by EN198 and CE EN14516:2015 CL1 PH, guaranteeing that the final product is of the highest quality.Beaufort's precise mould calibration delivers an impossibly silky finish, arguably the best on the market. The result is a bath that not only looks great but is also built to last. Experience the Beaufort difference and enjoy the ultimate in luxury and comfort with a bath that truly embodies the wave of British quality.

item.title: SBC - 12 Jet Beaufort Malin DE 1600 x 700 mm Double Ended Whirlpool Bath
item.description: Indulge in the ultimate relaxation experience with the Malin whirlpool bath. Crafted with narrow edges on three sides, its sleek and ultra-modern design not only enhances aesthetics but also maximizes internal bathing space, surpassing other baths of similar dimensions.At 1600 x 700 mm, this double-ended bath offers a rare size ideal for customers seeking versatility within limited length options.Our whirlpool system sets the benchmark for excellence, delivering unparalleled quality at an unbeatable price. Each bath is meticulously built to order and dispatched from South Wales, utilizing premium European-manufactured parts. Years of rigorous testing on various part combinations ensure you receive exceptional value for your investment, unmatched by any other whirlpool system in the UK.Unlike 'off-the-shelf' options, we prioritize your satisfaction by offering fully customized solutions tailored to your preferences.Featuring a dynamic 12-jet configuration, this bath includes three large massage jets with directional eyeballs, targeting the torso and legs on each side. Additionally, four mini-back jets cater to the neck, shoulders, and back, while two mini-foot jets soothe tired feet. Experience unparalleled luxury and relaxation with every soak in the Malin whirlpool bath. Our Beaufort Malin baths are 440 mm deep and supplied without tap holes; your installer will drill these if required.(tap & waste shown for illustration only)The option to upgrade to Beauforte, a super-strong reinforcement layer that is added to the underside of the bath. See the description below for details.Key Features440 mm deep210 litresBrilliant white sanitary-grade acrylicBeauforte reinforcement optionTechnical Drawing (opens new window)12 Jet Whirlpool System *6 chrome directional side jets *4 mini back jets*2 mini foot jets*Air flow controller to control the jet power with integrated On / Off Switch * Diverter valve, which allows you to select which jets are on together*Safety suction * Dry-run-safe pump, which protects the pump should it be turned on accidentally without water*1.10 HP pumpUpgrade to a Beauforte reinforced shell?What is Beauforte? Beauforte baths are twice as strong as standard acrylic baths.They ensure water stays warmer for longer than in a cast-iron or steel-enameled bath.They have a unique cradle system; this has been designed to cope with the additional weight of the Beauforte material.Once installed, the bath's stability and rigidity prevent movement, thus offering the perfect solution to the problem of sealing.They are 25% more slip-resistant than a cast iron or steel enameled bath.To upgrade your bath, select your upgrade from the Additional Options boxes above, and your basket total will be automatically updated. Optional ExtrasIf you would like to upgrade your bath with Chromotherapy Lighting, Brass Jets, Water Heaters, and Bath Panels, please visit our Upgrades Page or select them below.WarrantyWe offer a comprehensive 3-year warranty on each Beaufort bath, ensuring that every aspect of the bath, including the electronics and whirlpool system, is covered. Moreover, if you feel the need to extend your warranty beyond the initial 3-year period, you can do so at any time for just £45 per year, giving you even more peace of mind.

item.description: The Beaufort Biscay 1700 x 700 mm Single-Ended Whirlpool Bath is a deep and spacious, stunning bathing solution. The modern curves with straight sides and sloping back offer a luxurious bathing experience. Made in the UK from 100% sanitary grade white acrylic. Our Biscay baths are all 440 mm deep and supplied without tap holes; your installer will drill these if required. item.title: Hygiene+ Maximum Hygiene Solution Bundle
item.description: A whirlpool bath should feel as fresh as it looks. Hygienie+ is our premium hygiene solution—a factory-prepared add-on that sanitises the water in use, empties the system more thoroughly after every soak, and provides cleaning products to keep the pipework in good condition.Important: Hygiene+ is an upgrade for your bath purchase. It does not include a bath. A dedicated waste is included and fitted, ready for the drain-down pump, so please do not add a separate pop-up waste to the same order.Tap compatibility: Because of the specialist drain-down waste system, Hygenie+ is not compatible with overflow bath fillers. You will need a standard bath mixer, bath taps or a bath shower mixer.What’s includedFive products, supplied together as a cost-saving hygiene bundle:1 x whirlpool ozonator — fitted to the bath and ready to use; connect to the power supply1 x Koller 1.10HP drain-down pump — the same proven pump, with an evacuation connection so the pump can empty itself automatically1 x dedicated waste — fitted to the bath so the drain-down pump connects with less work for you or your installer1 x pack of 30 sterilising tablets1 x 1 litre bottle of degreasing cleaning fluidHow each part worksOzonator. Fitted to your bath, this device helps remove harmful bacteria during the whirlpool water cycle. It acts as a natural sanitiser to destroy bacteria and viruses and to break down oils and soap residues on contact, reducing the need for heavy chemical disinfectants. Once fitted it simply needs connecting to the power supply.Drain-down pump. This is our same Koller 1.10HP pump, specified with an evacuation connection. Pipework drains to the pump, and the pump then empties itself through the dedicated waste — a lower-maintenance way to reduce standing water in the system.Dedicated waste. Fitted to the bath before despatch, so there is less work on site. The drain-down pump connects to this waste for a cleaner, more complete empty. This specialist waste is why overflow bath fillers cannot be used with Hygenie+.Cleaning pack. Use the sterilising tablets for regular after-bath care and the 1 litre degreasing fluid for periodic deep cleans of the pipework, following the instructions supplied with each product.Key featuresOur most complete hygiene package in one add-onOzonator sanitises during the whirlpool cycleDrain-down pump automatically evacuates via a dedicated wasteWaste fitted ready, so you should not order a separate pop-up wasteNot compatible with overflow bath fillers — use a standard bath mixer, bath taps or bath shower mixer30 sterilising tablets plus 1 litre degreasing cleaner includedCost-saving bundle versus buying each item on its ownSpecificationProduct: Hygiene+ Maximum Hygiene Solution BundleType: Whirlpool bath upgrade/add-on (bath not included)Pump: Koller 1.10HP with drain-down / evacuation connectionSanitising: fitted ozonator (power connection required)Waste: dedicated drain-down waste, factory-fitted to the bathTap compatibility: standard bath mixer, bath taps or bath shower mixer only — not compatible with overflow bath fillersConsumables: 30 sterilising tablets and 1 litre degreasing cleaning fluidFinish/images: images are for illustration onlyHow to orderChoose your whirlpool bath.Add Hygiene+ to the same order.Do not add a pop-up waste — one is already included in this bundle.Do not add an overflow bath filler. Choose a standard bath mixer, bath taps or a bath shower mixer instead.For a new bath, we fit the ozonator, drain-down pump and dedicated waste before despatch. You then connect the ozonator to the power supply as directed.Frequently asked questionsDoes Hygiene+ include a bath?No. This is an upgrade only. Purchase a compatible whirlpool bath and add Hygenie+ to the order.Should I still add a pop-up waste?No. A dedicated waste is included and fitted as part of this bundle. Adding a second waste is not required.Can I use an overflow bath filler with Hygiene+?No. The specialist drain-down waste system is not compatible with overflow bath fillers. You will need a standard bath mixer, bath taps or a bath shower mixer.Is the ozonator ready to use?Yes. It is fitted to the bath. It only needs to be connected to the power supply.What is different about the pump?It is the same Koller 1.10HP whirlpool pump, but with an evacuation connection so residual water can be pumped away through the dedicated waste rather than left standing in the system.Are the cleaning products a one-off supply?Yes — the bundle includes one pack of 30 sterilising tablets and one 1 litre bottle of degreasing fluid to start your care routine. Replacement tablets and cleaner can be ordered separately when needed.Are the images exactly as supplied?Images are for illustration only.

item.title: Whirlpool Bath Ozonator
item.description: A whirlpool bath should feel as clean as it feels indulgent. Our factory-fitted Ozonator treats the water while the jets are running, using ozone — nature’s own oxidiser — to help keep the circulating water fresher with less reliance on heavy chemical disinfectants.Important: this is an add-on to your bath purchase. It does not include a bath. The ozonator is fitted to the bath, ready to use, and only needs to be connected to the power supply.How the ozonator worksOzone is a form of oxygen with three atoms instead of two, written as O3. That extra oxygen atom makes ozone a powerful oxidiser. When it meets impurities in the water, it reacts on contact and breaks them down.In a whirlpool bath, the process is simple:You start the whirlpool cycle and water begins to circulate through the pump and jets.The fitted ozonator produces a controlled amount of ozone and introduces it into that circulating water.Ozone attacks organic matter on contact — including bacteria, viruses, body oils and soap residues that would otherwise linger in the water and pipework.Once ozone has done its work, it naturally reverts to ordinary oxygen (O2). It does not leave a heavy chemical residual in the bath in the way chlorine-based treatments can.The longer the whirlpool runs, the more of the circulating water is treated. That is why the ozonator is most effective during a normal soak, not as a stand-alone cleaner when the bath is empty.It does not replace wiping the bath or occasional pipework care. What it does do is give you a continuous sanitising action every time you use the jets, so you can rely less on strong chemical disinfectants.Why customers add itFresher water while you bathe — treatment happens during the whirlpool cycle, not after you have finished.Less hidden build-up — oils and soap residues are oxidised in the circulating water before they settle in the system.A lighter care routine — reduces the need for heavy chemical disinfectants as part of everyday use.No extra routine on the day — once connected to power, it works with the system; you do not dose it each bath.Factory fitted — added to your bath before despatch, so there is nothing to install beyond a power connection.What’s included1 x whirlpool ozonator, factory fitted to your chosen bathOnce the bath arrives, connect the ozonator to the power supply as directed. No further assembly of the unit itself is required.Key featuresFitted to the bath before despatchProduces ozone (O3) and introduces it into the circulating whirlpool waterOxidises bacteria, viruses, oils and soap residues on contactOzone then returns to ordinary oxygenReduces the need for heavy chemical disinfectantsReady to use — just connect to the power supplySpecificationProduct: Whirlpool Bath OzonatorType: Whirlpool bath hygiene upgrade/add-on (bath not included)Sanitising method: ozone (O3) introduced during the whirlpool water cycleInstallation: factory fitted to the bathOn site: connect to the power supplyImages: for illustration onlyHow to orderChoose your whirlpool bath.Add this Ozonator to the same order.We fit the ozonator at the factory before the bath is dispatched. You then connect it to the power supply when the bath is installed.Frequently asked questionsDoes this include a bath?No. This is an upgrade only. Purchase a compatible whirlpool bath and add the ozonator to the order.Is ozone safe in a home bath?The unit is designed for whirlpool use and introduces ozone into the circulating water during the jet cycle. After reacting, ozone reverts to ordinary oxygen. Follow the fitting and power-connection guidance supplied with the bath.Will I smell ozone?A faint fresh smell can sometimes be noticed while the system is running. That is the ozone working. It should not linger once the cycle has finished and the gas has returned to oxygen.Does it replace sterilising tablets or cleaner?No. The ozonator treats water while the jets run. Tablets and degreasing fluid are still useful for after-bath and periodic pipework care. Together they are a stronger hygiene routine; this upgrade simply does the sanitising automatically during use.Is it ready to use?Yes. It is fitted to the bath. It only needs to be connected to the power supply.Can I add this to a bath I already own?Please contact us to check. This listing is intended as a factory-fitted upgrade on a new bath order.Are the images exactly as supplied?Images are for illustration only.

item.title: Gunmetal Smartflow Round Overflow Filler
item.description: The Tavistock Smartflow Round Overflow Bath Filler in gunmetal is a modern way to control the water flow in your bath. Water runs into the bath through the filler rather than a traditional bath mixer tap, keeping the rim of the bath clear.Mounted on the inside of the bath, it acts as a combined filler and overflow, and it comes with a click waste.
